annotations.title: Check if a Dutch company is bankrupt (paid)

description: Dutch company insolvency check (faillissementscheck, KvK) from the Centraal Insolventieregister of de Rechtspraak: active bankruptcy or suspension of payments, ended cases still in the register, court, case number, dates, curator/administrator and claims deadline. Legal entities only. For KYB, credit-risk, supplier and onboarding agents checking a business counterparty. Input: KvK number (exact) or company name. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402, or 5 credits of a Factline API key.
name: nl_insolvency_check
title: Check if a Dutch company is bankrupt (paid)
